b: Your scanners find an ancient warship drifting without power, its hull etched with Starwright script no one has read in a thousand years.

o.s: Risky. Could hold founders’ tech, could hold something awake.
+35 credits, no risk.

o.l: Cut out its core with lances
o.s: A clean cut: founders’ tech and salvage, nothing wakes.
Nothing happens.

b: A Hegemony supply tender is limping home with a shattered drive. Its captain is broadcasting on every band.

o.s: Your crews patch their drive. They pay in kind.

o.l: Tow them home with a carrier
o.s: Their captain pays well and owes you one: +70 credits, a Nemesis weakness revealed.
+100 credits. Their escort might remember your colours.
Nothing happens.

b: Your signals officer has pulled an old founders’ beacon out of the static. Old salvage lies beyond it, but reaching it means crossing a rift.

hegemony.b: Your sensor officer has decoded a ghost signal: an old Navy salvage cache, deep inside a rift.

corsair.b: Your best tracker swears she can smell old metal on the far side of a rift. She is usually right. Usually.

chorus.b: The swarm tastes something old and delicious beyond a rift.

ithar.b: Your mirrors catch a glint of old Starwright glass beyond a rift: a lost treasure of your people.

deathless.b: An Archive beacon from before the collapse pulses beyond a rift. Something of Ardent is still out there.

o.s: Gain salvage. A random ship takes heavy damage.

o.l: Shield the route with a spare refit
o.s: Gain salvage. A refit from the hold burns out instead of a hull.
Nothing happens.

b: A scarred destroyer captain hails you. Her crew has been paid off and she wants a new cause, for a price.

o.s: A destroyer of your own kind, with a veteran captain, joins the fleet.

o.l: Offer her a place in the line, no pay
o.s: She takes the oath. A destroyer of your own kind joins with a veteran captain.
Nothing happens.

b: A storm front rolls across your jump route, lightning the colour of old blood.

o.s: Every ship takes 10% hull damage.

o.l: Angle every shield into the front
o.s: No damage, and your captains learn from it: +10 experience each.
Burn fuel and time instead.

b: A lone Glasswright vessel matches your course. Its keeper offers a trade: one of your refits for one of their treasures.

o.s: Lose a random installed module. Gain salvage.
She trades salvage for the courtesy. No refit lost.
Nothing happens.

b: A hermit shipwright on an asteroid forge offers to rework one of your hulls. He asks only for the stories of your battles.

o.s: Your most damaged ship is fully repaired and upgraded one Mark.

o.l: Pay him in refits too (one from the hold)
o.s: Your most damaged ship is repaired and upgraded, and a second ship is fully repaired.
Nothing happens.

b: Chorus spores have taken a mining moon. Survivors are signalling from the deep shafts, but a brood is gestating.

o.s: Fight an elite Chorus battle. Win salvage.

o.l: Sweep the shafts with point defense
o.s: Rescue the survivors before the brood hatches: +60 credits, +15 experience for every captain.
+20 captain experience for every captain.

b: A memorial station hangs over a dead world, its walls chalked with the names of a crusade that never came home. Your crews ask to leave an offering.

hegemony.b: An old memorial station hangs over a dead world. Spacers are a superstitious lot, and your crews ask to leave an offering.

corsair.b: An old memorial station hangs over a dead world, heaped with other packs’ trophies. Your crews want to leave one of their own.

ithar.t: A mirror of the old world
ithar.b: A mirror array from before your people’s fall still turns over a dead world. Your crews ask to leave an offering.

o.s: Every ship repairs 30% hull.
Even odds: repair 30%, or nothing.

o.l: Leave a piece of salvage as an offering
o.s: Every ship is fully repaired and every captain gains 20 experience.
Nothing happens.

b: An escape pod of Hegemony officers begs for asylum. They know how the Navy fights.

o.s: Your least experienced captain gains 60 experience.

o.l: Question them about the enemy commander
o.s: Your least experienced captain gains 30 experience and a Nemesis weakness is revealed.

o.l: Hand them back for the bounty
o.s: +60 credits.

b: A Hullbreaker cache hidden in the rings of a gas giant. The locks are primitive.

o.s: Gain a random module.

o.l: Crack it with a torpedo, then strip the fuel
o.s: A refit and the credits.
+45 credits.

b: An abandoned toll station turns slowly in the dark, its vault still sealed. The alarm circuits look old, but alive.

o.s: +70 credits. The alarm will reach someone: the Nemesis clock moves on.

o.l: Cut the vault open with a lance
o.s: +70 credits, quietly.
Nothing happens.

b: A lone life pod drifts across your course. Inside, a fighter pilot clutches the logbook of a wing that no longer exists.

o.s: Your least experienced captain gains 40 experience from her stories.

o.l: Give her a wing on your carrier
o.s: Your best carrier’s wings gain a veteran perk.

o.l: Leave her to the rescue buoys
o.s: Nothing happens.

b: Engineers report a hairline crack in a reactor housing. It will hold for a battle, perhaps two.

o.s: Your largest ship takes 20% hull damage.

o.l: Rebuild it around a spare refit
o.s: A refit from the hold is used up. No damage.

o.l: Let the repair drones knit it
o.s: No cost.

o.l: Buy parts from a passing hauler (45 credits)
o.s: No damage.

b: A wall of ion static rolls toward the fleet. It will scour paint, sensors and anything not shielded.

o.s: Every ship takes 8% hull damage.

o.l: Bring the shields up and push through
o.s: No damage; captains learn from it: +10 experience each.
No damage.

b: A soft-spoken broker hails you from a cloaked yacht. She claims to know the enemy commander who has been shadowing your fleet.

o.s: A Nemesis weakness is revealed.

o.l: Remind her of an old debt
o.s: She pays it in secrets: a Nemesis weakness, free.
Nothing happens.

t: A distress call that sounds wrong
b: A freighter screams for help on every band. Your signals officer thinks the voice is a recording.

o.l: Go in loud and take the cargo
o.s: +80 credits, but your next fight starts as an ambush.

o.l: Sweep it with point defense first
o.s: You find the mines and take the cargo: +80 credits.
Nothing happens.

b: Thousands of translucent egg-sacs drift between two moons, pulsing in time with something far away.

o.s: +20 experience for every captain.
Gain a damage control refit.
Every ship regrows 30% of its hull.

b: A dying Glasswright prism rings with one long clear tone as its light fades. The tone carries old star charts in it, for those who can read it.

o.s: Every captain gains 15 experience.
Gain salvage, and the charts show you the enemy commander’s routes: Nemesis clock back one.
Lose a piece of salvage. Reveal a Nemesis weakness and gain 120 credits.

b: A ring of black collectors circles a dimming star, drinking its energy. Something aboard counts the seconds until you come in range.

o.l: Break the array and take what it guards
o.s: Fight an elite Eclipse battle. Win salvage.
+30 credits for the charts.

b: An Eclipse yard from before the collapse drifts in the dark, its hulls stored without minds. A copy from the Archive would wake one of them.

o.s: An Eclipse mote joins the fleet at full hull.
+60 credits.

b: The crew of one of your ships has gone quiet in the wrong way. Their captain asks for orders.

o.s: The mood lifts.
Your flagship captain loses 20 experience; the fleet falls in line.

o.l: Send your most senior captain to talk
o.s: Free, and that captain gains 15 experience.

b: A slow convoy of ore haulers asks for safe passage through the next system.

o.s: +45 credits from the grateful masters.
Gain a random refit.
+100 credits. Word spreads: the Nemesis clock moves on.

b: Hulls from a war nobody remembers drift in a slow ring, still bristling with unexploded ordnance.

o.s: Gain a random refit. One ship takes 12% hull damage from old mines.
They find the mines: a random refit, no damage.
Nothing happens.

b: Long-range scans show a small, fast ship holding exactly at the edge of your sensor range. It carries the enemy commander’s colours.

o.s: Every ship takes 5% hull damage in the chase. Nemesis clock back one, and a weakness revealed.
Nemesis clock back one, and a weakness revealed. No damage.
The Nemesis clock moves on.

b: An officer from the enemy commander’s own fleet surrenders his shuttle to you. He wants asylum and he wants revenge.

o.s: A Nemesis weakness is revealed.
+70 credits. The Nemesis clock moves on.
Your least experienced captain gains 50 experience and a weakness is revealed.

b: An automated drydock still runs on its last power cells. Its arms twitch as your fleet comes alongside.

o.s: Your most damaged ship is fully repaired.
Your most damaged ship is repaired and upgraded one Mark.
Nothing happens.

b: A dead star bends the route ahead. A tight slingshot would save fuel, if the hulls can take the stress.

o.s: Every ship takes 5% hull damage; you save 35 credits of fuel.
No damage, and you save the fuel: +35 credits.
Nothing happens.

b: A neutral station is auctioning salvage recovered from a dead crusade. The bidding is slow and the buyers are armed.

o.s: Gain salvage.

o.l: Trade a piece of your salvage for one of theirs
o.s: Lose a piece of salvage, gain a different piece and 40 credits.
Nothing happens.

b: Small failures keep happening on one of your ships. Someone aboard is working for the enemy commander.

o.s: A firefight: that ship takes 10% hull damage. A weakness is revealed from his notes.
The defector you questioned named him. Caught quietly: Nemesis clock back one, and a weakness revealed.
The Nemesis clock moves on twice.

b: An old admiral in a ruined hab offers to teach your captains everything she learned, for a price.

o.s: Every captain gains 25 experience.
She teaches for free: every captain gains 25 experience.
Nothing happens.

b: A rock riddled with docking tunnels and gun ports. Half the sector’s stolen goods pass through here.

o.s: Fight an elite Hullbreaker battle. Win salvage.

o.l: Pay them to hide your trail (40 credits)
o.s: Nemesis clock back one.
A Hullbreaker raider joins with a veteran captain.

b: Nothing on the scopes for light-hours in every direction. The crews sleep for the first time in weeks.

o.s: Every ship repairs 10% of its hull.
Every captain gains 10 experience.
